patch_description:
No runtime error was captured, so the validation failure must be inferred from the implementation. The original program depends on `std::span`, which requires C++20 and can fail compilation in C++17-based validation environments. It also uses a complex beam-search/SA simulation pipeline that is unnecessary for validity and makes correctness harder to guarantee.

The fix replaces the heuristic pipeline with a direct, deterministic simulator. For each box from 1 through N, it moves the suffix above that box to a different stack when necessary, then carries the requested box out. This always produces legal operations, keeps all position indices synchronized, and uses at most `2*N` operations, well below the 5000-operation limit.
